entities.name: PMID:27502089
observations: In 106 Indian domestic cats, 12 (11.3%) were CPV/FPV-positive; VP2 sequencing identified two CPV-2a strains and three FPV strains.
The authors described the CPV-2a strains as newer variants and reported ongoing evolution based on amino-acid changes.

entities.name: PMID:35493752
observations: Southern Indian domestic and shelter cats showed FPV and CPV infections in full-length VP2 analysis.
The study reported three previously unreported VP2 mutations and a potential CPV-2a/FPV recombinant sequence, supporting emerging molecular features.

entities.name: PMID:42654988
observations: In 180 clinically suspected Chennai cats, 83 (46.11%) were FPV-PCR-positive; partial VP2 sequences showed 98.1–98.5% identity to a vaccine reference and additional substitutions.
The study documented genetically diverse circulating FPV but did not establish a clearly named novel variant.

entities.name: Indian cat parvovirus emergence
observations: Indian domestic-cat studies report newer molecular features: 2017 CPV-2a variants and 2022 novel VP2 substitutions plus a potential CPV-2a/FPV recombinant.
Evidence supports emergence of newly described genetic variants, but most data are VP2-based and do not by themselves prove a new antigenic lineage or biologically confirmed recombinant.
